summary.text: Ryan Neill is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 74, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican Nick Pachota; there is no incumbent in the race.
Neill says he was born and raised in Sarasota and lists affordable insurance, affordable housing and flood control funding as campaign priorities.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Neill graduated from Sarasota High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of South Florida in 2005, according to Ballotpedia, and his career experience includes working in retail.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he named securing affordable insurance, affordable housing, and funding for flood control and mitigation as his key messages, and listed investment in mass transit as an area of policy he is passionate about.
